st: From search engine to research that will be the engine of future technologies.

sec.t: ff.28.1 Artificial intelligence for nuclear fusion
sec.p: Nuclear fusion has been predicted for decades, as we discussed in 🎼 ff.12 Sun, heart and love.

sec.t: ff.28.2 Finding the bean in the jar
sec.p: X, the moonshot factory, is a Google-linked company that does cool stuff.

Google has implemented an eco-friendly routing system on Maps. By avoiding traffic jams, and therefore more time with the engine running, it already helps cut emissions. It has also recently added options for bikes and e-scooters and started integrating charging stations for…

sec.t: ff.28.4 Wear your vest (or are you feeling lucky?)
sec.p: Google has launched a data management platform called Care Studio, which presents the doctors of the future with a given patient's health data, ensuring simple, AI-assisted access. There's a short video showing how it works.
